areas.t: Tuesday, November 17: As a surface high-pressure system settles over the state, light southwesterly winds will transport regional pollutants into the Mahoning Valley. Furthermore, morning and evening temperature inversions will hinder low-level mixing. As a result, AQI levels will be mid-Moderate.

Tuesday Afternoon Update: As of 3:00pm Tuesday, the air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is mostly in the good range.
